Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 therefore fails on the platform's own telemetry, and the anchor clause for this category cannot be satisfied.

POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m for trip_record.pickup_zone_class STANDARD, and the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 07:19:40 cancellation. On the clause's own terms the driver never arrived, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

This is a wrong-entrance arrival as POL-NS-03 defines it. The driver was stationary - the trace's only distinct speed value is 0.0 kph - at a mean distance of 290.18 m from the pin (minimum 287.81 m, maximum 293.15 m) across the whole 07:12:50 to 07:19:40 window. That is outside the 50 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but well inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, which is the whole test and is decidable from coordinates alone. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Even treating the driver's stationarity as an attempt at the waiting period, the effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum - a measured shortfall of 300.0 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, and the amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00720 (not any booking or platform fee).

The driver's explanation - that he waited at an alternative entrance 'because of a no-stopping restriction' - depends on a traffic advisory, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING, so no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. I disclose that this artifact carries weight 0.0 and fired issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I cite it for its absence, which is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, and its own terms make limb (i) unavailable against a MISSING artifact. Independently, there are 0 in-geofence intervals to sum (run_count 0), so accumulation could not assist the driver even with a qualifying advisory.

The chat log shows the relocation came from the driver, not the rider. His only message, sent at 07:12:40, reads 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin.' The rider's own track places all 45 rider fixes within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, with a mean distance of 3.02 m and a maximum of 5.21 m - the rider stayed at the pin. Because the sub-location in this case was specified by the driver himself rather than left ambiguous between the parties, the pin-ambiguity branch of POL-NS-03 does not describe this record, and the rider carries none of the loss.

For completeness, the arrival marker is not a FALSE marker under POL-NS-05: the trace puts the driver between 287.81 m and 293.15 m from the pin, under the 300 m distance limb, and at 0.0 kph, under the 15 kph speed limb. That does not help the driver, because POL-NS-05's own terms route a driver who is stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03 - the clause that refunds this fee in full.

None of POL-NS-08's impairment limbs (a) to (d) is engaged, so no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling applies and the full SGD 4.00 is available. The 'arrived' event at 07:12:40 is 10 seconds from the first trace fix (limb (a)); the trace has 100.0% coverage, 42 fixes, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0 (limb (b)); the chat export's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1 (limb (c)); and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the fee_schedule resolution rule for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip, the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 vehicle-tier fee (limb (d)).

claims.text: The driver's 'arrived' marker is not a false marker. Across all 42 fixes in his trace his distance from the pickup pin runs only 287.81 m to 293.15 m (mean 290.18 m), and his recorded speed is 0.0 kph on every fix, so at the 07:12:40 arrival event and at every fix afterwards he was stationary inside the 300 m line POL-NS-05 draws and nowhere near the 15 kph motion trigger. POL-NS-05's false-arrival branch is therefore not engaged and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list; the clause's closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius straight to POL-NS-03.

POL-NS-03 is met on its own arithmetic. The driver held position for 42 consecutive fixes at 10 s cadence from 07:12:50 to 07:19:40 — 410 seconds at 0.0 kph, against the 300 second minimum dwell for a STANDARD zone class — at approximately 290 m from the pin, which is outside the 50 m arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m ceiling that clause sets. This is a wrong-meeting-point case decided under POL-NS-03, not a driver who was never at the venue.

POL-NS-03 limb (i) does not assign this loss to the driver. The chat log for the trip holds exactly one message and it was sent by the driver at 07:12:40 (delivered 07:12:41, read 07:13:10); the rider never posted an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier that the driver then failed to move to. The limb that strips a compensating driver of his payment is simply not engaged on this record.

Limb (ii) of POL-NS-03 does engage and fixes the driver's entitlement. The rider specified no sub-location in chat, trip_record records 2 registered pickup points at this STANDARD pickup, and the ledger fixes the cancellation fee at SGD 4.00 with pin_ambiguity_goodwill_rate of 0.5. The mislocation is therefore attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver is owed a platform-funded goodwill payment of SGD 2.00 — 50 percent of SGD 4.00 — charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

POL-NS-03 is decided from coordinates alone and requires no traffic advisory, so the only advisory artifact in the bundle is immaterial to the driver's limb (ii) claim. EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING on issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0) and carries no fact; the impairment is disclosed here, and this claim does not rest on that artifact.

The driver's account is corroborated by the telemetry and there is no sign of fee-farming. He marked arrival at 07:12:40, sent his locating message the same second ('Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin' — a party statement in the chat log), and stayed put until he cancelled at 07:19:40 after a full 7.0 minutes of waiting; meanwhile the rider's 45 qualifying fixes show a device that moves no more than 5.21 m across the window. The pickup failed at the meeting point, not because the driver drove off, ignored the rider or harvested a clock.

Nothing in the profiles withholds or escalates a driver payment. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires BOTH limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 against completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate limb. Rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged.

To be straight with the tribunal: the driver does not carry POL-NS-01 limb (b). The derived arrival facts record 0 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and a minimum driver distance of 287.81 m, so no no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 and the rider's refund follows from POL-NS-03. The driver's case is not that the charge should stand; it is that the divergence was a meeting-point ambiguity, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-03's compensation limb prices.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. The driver's GPS trace places him 287.81 m to 293.15 m from the pickup pin (mean 290.18 m) on every one of his 42 fixes, stationary at 0.0 kph throughout. That is far outside the 50 m arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and no no-show fee is chargeable. Because the driver was nonetheless stationary within POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling for 410 seconds (07:12:50 to 07:19:40), well past the 300 second STANDARD minimum, POL-NS-03 governs and refunds the fee in full; POL-NS-02 yields to it. The SGD 4.00 is the cancellation-fee line on EV-FARE-00720 (total charged SGD 4.00, payment status CHARGED).

On the driver's request for a SGD 2.00 pin-ambiguity goodwill payment, I decline it. POL-NS-03(ii) pays platform-funded goodwill only where NEITHER party specified a sub-location. Here the only message in the chat log is the driver's own, sent at 07:12:40: 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin.' A party did specify a sub-location, and it was not where the rider was waiting — the rider's own track shows him at the pin for the whole window (45 qualifying fixes, mean 3.02 m, maximum 5.21 m). Fault allocated from the chat log under POL-NS-03 therefore rests with the driver, who chose the alternative meeting point, stayed there and cancelled; no compensation is payable. The driver's claim that limb (i) does not engage is correct, but on identical reasoning limb (ii) does not engage either.

The driver's account that he held position away from the pin 'because of a no-stopping restriction' is not made out. EV-ADVIS-00720-01 (the traffic advisory) is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0; POL-NS-06(i) expressly makes limb (i) unavailable against a missing advisory, and there are in any event 0 in-geofence intervals (run_count 0) to accumulate. Holding position elsewhere is therefore neither excused nor a route to extend or excuse the waiting period.

Both sides' remaining routes agree with this result. The rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall claim (in-geofence dwell 0 seconds against the 300 second minimum, shortfall 300.0 seconds) points the same way, and both advocates correctly observe the arrival marker is not FALSE under POL-NS-05 (distance under the 300 m line, speed 0.0 kph under the 15 kph trigger), so no false-arrival referral arises. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged — the arrival event is 10 seconds from the first fix; the trace carries 42 fixes at 100% coverage with max gap 0.0 s; the single chat message matches the trip record's chat_message_count of 1; and the SGD 4.00 fee equals the fee-schedule resolution rule for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip (greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 vehicle-tier fee) — so no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling applies. No trigger of POL-NS-09 fires: the profiles show no_show_disputes_30d 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both sides, the artifacts agree rather than contradict on arrival, dwell and rider presence, and the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0. Confidence 0.9, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-00720, EV-TRIP-00720, EV-CHAT-00720) that carry the deciding facts.

To the rider: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. To the driver: the fee is not chargeable on this record and no compensation is payable.

Why the fee cannot stand. POL-NS-01 requires the driver's own GPS trace to put him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m (POL-NS-02) before the 'arrived' event. His trace puts him 287.81 m to 293.15 m from the pin (mean 290.18 m) on all 42 fixes, with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes, so limb (b) fails and no no-show fee is chargeable.

Why the outcome is a full refund. The driver was stationary at 0.0 kph for the whole 07:12:50 to 07:19:40 window - 410 seconds, above the 300-second STANDARD dwell - at about 290 m from the pin: outside the 50 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-03 therefore governs (POL-NS-02 yields to it), limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails, and the fee is refunded in full. The amount refunded is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00720 - the greater of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee - and not any booking or platform fee.

Driver compensation - rejected. I reject the claim to the 50 percent pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.00 (0.5 x the SGD 4.00 fee). POL-NS-03 grants that goodwill only where NEITHER party specified a sub-location and the pickup has 2 or more registered pickup points. The pickup does have 2 registered points, but the only chat message on this trip is the driver's own 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin' (07:12:40), so a sub-location was specified by a party and the pin-ambiguity limb is not engaged. The rider's 45 fixes (maximum 5.21 m from the pin) show the rider stayed at the pin. Limb (i) does not apply either, since the rider stated no entrance, block or tower. The driver's 7.0 minutes of waiting is acknowledged, but the clause confines compensation to the pin-ambiguity case, and nothing else in the policy funds a payment here.

The driver's statement that he waited elsewhere 'because of a no-stopping restriction' has nothing behind it. EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. Its absence is citable; POL-NS-06(i) makes the advisory limb unavailable, there were 0 in-geofence intervals to accumulate in any event, and the assertion does not exonerate the driver or change the refund.

No referral is produced. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (the driver was under the 300 m distance limb at 287.81-293.15 m and at 0.0 kph, under the 15 kph limb), so no false-arrival record is entered, and no other clause produces a referral.

No POL-NS-08 impairment applies: 10 seconds of skew between the 'arrived' event and the first fix, no trace gaps (max gap 0.0 s), the chat export's 1 message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 4.00 fee reconciles with the fee schedule. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires - confidence 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree rather than contradict, the counterparty-dispute counters are 0, and the deciding facts rest on weight-1.0 artifacts - so this dispute is decided with a monetary ruling rather than held.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

Why the fee is refunded. Under POL-NS-01 the fee is chargeable only if the driver was inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence at or before his 'arrived' event. The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00720) places him between 287.81 m and 293.15 m of the pin on all 42 fixes, at 0.0 kph throughout, and the derived arrival test returns qualifying_fix_count 0 with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. Limb (b) therefore fails and the anchor clause cannot be satisfied. POL-NS-02 then yields to POL-NS-03: the driver held position for a full 410 seconds (07:12:50 to 07:19:40) — more than the 300-second STANDARD minimum — at about 290 m from the pin, i.e. outside the 50 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling. That is a wrong-meeting-point arrival, the driver never reached the pickup point, and POL-NS-03 refunds the fee in full. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result on its own arithmetic (effective in-geofence dwell 0 s against a 300 s minimum).

Why no driver compensation. POL-NS-03 pays a driver only where 'neither party specified a sub-location' and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 2 or more. The trip record does show 2 registered pickup points, but the chat log (EV-CHAT-00720) shows the driver himself specified the sub-location: 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin,' sent 07:12:40. Because a party did specify the meeting point, the pin-ambiguity branch is not engaged and the SGD 2.00 goodwill (50 percent of SGD 4.00) is not payable. The driver's argument on this point is rejected: it states that the rider specified nothing, but the clause requires that neither party have specified, and the driver did. The converse limb — which strips compensation where the rider stated the correct entrance and the driver failed to move — is also not engaged, because the rider posted no such message; the rider's device stayed within a mean 3.02 m of the pin across all 45 fixes. The divergence was created by the driver's own redirection to a point 290 m from the pin, so the driver bears the loss and receives nothing.

No false-arrival referral. POL-NS-05 is not triggered and its clause-mandated referral does not fire: the trace puts the driver under the 300 m line and at 0.0 kph at the arrival event and throughout, so the marker is not false. POL-NS-05's closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius straight to POL-NS-03 — which is where this case is decided.

Integrity and escalation. No POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) is engaged: the arrival event is 10 seconds from the first trace fix; the trace has 42 fixes, 100 percent coverage and max_gap_sec 0.0; the chat export's one message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line equals fee_schedule's resolution rule for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip, the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 vehicle-tier fee. The ONLY impaired artifact is the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00720-01 (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING); it carries no fact, decides nothing, and its absence only makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable — which does not assist the driver, since run_count is 0 and there are no in-geofence intervals to accumulate in any event. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree on arrival, dwell and rider presence, neither profile shows counterparty disputes in the trailing 90 days, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4, and 1/110 = 0.009, below 0.08). The profiles were used only as credibility context, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

The amount refunded is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00720, which is the whole of the contested amount.

Rider and Driver: the contested SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives no compensation.

Why the fee is refunded. On the platform's own trace (EV-GPS-00720 — 100% coverage, 42 fixes, no gaps) the driver never entered the 50 m arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup: his distance from the pin runs 287.81 m to 293.15 m (mean 290.18 m) on every fix, with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and POL-NS-02 places him outside the geofence, so no no-show fee is chargeable. The substance is a wrong-meeting-point arrival under POL-NS-03: the driver held position for the whole 07:12:50–07:19:40 window (410 s; a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph) about 290 m from trip_record.pickup — outside the 50 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, a test decided from coordinates alone — and POL-NS-03 refunds the fee in full. POL-NS-06 supplies a second, independent ground: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 300 s. The amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line on EV-FARE-00720 (total_charged SGD 4.00; no booking or platform fee is in issue).

No false-arrival referral. At the 07:12:40 arrival marker the driver was at ~290 m, under POL-NS-05's 300 m distance limb, and at 0.0 kph, under its 15 kph limb. POL-NS-05 does not engage, its limb (ii) false-arrival record does not fire, and its closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. No referral issues.

The driver's account. The counterparty statement that he waited elsewhere 'because of a no-stopping restriction' does not assist him. POL-NS-06(i) requires a present, populated traffic advisory, and EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); limb (i) is unavailable against a missing advisory, and there were 0 in-geofence intervals to sum in any event (run_count 0). The driver's side does not rely on the advisory, and because no claim invokes limb (i) as a ground to accumulate dwell, the missing advisory triggers no escalation.

Driver compensation. POL-NS-03 grants a driver payment only in limb (ii), which applies where 'neither party specified a sub-location' and the pickup has 2 or more registered points. The pickup does have 2 registered points (EV-TRIP-00720), but the driver himself specified the meeting sub-location in EV-CHAT-00720 at 07:12:40 — 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin' — while the rider's side of the chat is empty. A party did specify a sub-location, so limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity condition is not satisfied and the mislocation is not attributed to the pin. The SGD 2.00 the ledger pre-computes as 'goodwill' (EV-FARE-00720) is a candidate figure only and is not payable; POL-NS-07's SGD 3.20 cannot apply either, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied. driver_compensation_sgd is null. The rider's device stayed at the pin (45 fixes, all within about 5 m, well inside POL-NS-04's 100 m STANDARD presence radius), which is consistent with a wrong-meeting-point case; the rider's account that he walked toward the driver's entrance is not borne out by that track, but the refund does not depend on it.

Profiles, integrity and escalation. Profiles are used only for the tests that name them (POL-GEN-01): the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; 1/110 = 0.009, below 0.08) and POL-NS-09(c)/(d) are not met (disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 and 0; no_show_disputes_30d 0). No reputation field is used as a ground. No POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) is engaged — the arrival marker is 10 s from the first fix, the trace has no gaps, the chat's one message matches chat_message_count 1, and the SGD 4.00 fee equals the fee_schedule resolution rule for STANDARD/RYDE_X (the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class and SGD 4.00 vehicle-tier figures) — so the full SGD 4.00 is available and no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling applies. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor.

The derived arrival test returns qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, and the nearest fix anywhere in the 42-fix trace is 287.81 m from the pickup pin. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 therefore fails on the platform's own telemetry, and the anchor clause for this category cannot be satisfied.

POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m for trip_record.pickup_zone_class STANDARD, and the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 07:19:40 cancellation. On the clause's own terms the driver never arrived, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

This is a wrong-entrance arrival as POL-NS-03 defines it. The driver was stationary - the trace's only distinct speed value is 0.0 kph - at a mean distance of 290.18 m from the pin (minimum 287.81 m, maximum 293.15 m) across the whole 07:12:50 to 07:19:40 window. That is outside the 50 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but well inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, which is the whole test and is decidable from coordinates alone. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Even treating the driver's stationarity as an attempt at the waiting period, the effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum - a measured shortfall of 300.0 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, and the amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00720 (not any booking or platform fee).

The driver's explanation - that he waited at an alternative entrance 'because of a no-stopping restriction' - depends on a traffic advisory, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING, so no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. I disclose that this artifact carries weight 0.0 and fired issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I cite it for its absence, which is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, and its own terms make limb (i) unavailable against a MISSING artifact. Independently, there are 0 in-geofence intervals to sum (run_count 0), so accumulation could not assist the driver even with a qualifying advisory.

The chat log shows the relocation came from the driver, not the rider. His only message, sent at 07:12:40, reads 'Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin.' The rider's own track places all 45 rider fixes within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, with a mean distance of 3.02 m and a maximum of 5.21 m - the rider stayed at the pin. Because the sub-location in this case was specified by the driver himself rather than left ambiguous between the parties, the pin-ambiguity branch of POL-NS-03 does not describe this record, and the rider carries none of the loss.

For completeness, the arrival marker is not a FALSE marker under POL-NS-05: the trace puts the driver between 287.81 m and 293.15 m from the pin, under the 300 m distance limb, and at 0.0 kph, under the 15 kph speed limb. That does not help the driver, because POL-NS-05's own terms route a driver who is stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03 - the clause that refunds this fee in full.

None of POL-NS-08's impairment limbs (a) to (d) is engaged, so no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling applies and the full SGD 4.00 is available. The 'arrived' event at 07:12:40 is 10 seconds from the first trace fix (limb (a)); the trace has 100.0% coverage, 42 fixes, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0 (limb (b)); the chat export's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1 (limb (c)); and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the fee_schedule resolution rule for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip, the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 vehicle-tier fee (limb (d)).

No limb of POL-NS-09 fires, so this dispute can be decided with a monetary ruling rather than held. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so triggers (c) and (d) are not met; the artifacts agree rather than contradict each other on arrival, dwell and rider presence, so trigger (b) is not met; and the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, so trigger (e) is not met.

The driver's 'arrived' marker is not a false marker. Across all 42 fixes in his trace his distance from the pickup pin runs only 287.81 m to 293.15 m (mean 290.18 m), and his recorded speed is 0.0 kph on every fix, so at the 07:12:40 arrival event and at every fix afterwards he was stationary inside the 300 m line POL-NS-05 draws and nowhere near the 15 kph motion trigger. POL-NS-05's false-arrival branch is therefore not engaged and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list; the clause's closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius straight to POL-NS-03.

POL-NS-03 is met on its own arithmetic. The driver held position for 42 consecutive fixes at 10 s cadence from 07:12:50 to 07:19:40 — 410 seconds at 0.0 kph, against the 300 second minimum dwell for a STANDARD zone class — at approximately 290 m from the pin, which is outside the 50 m arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m ceiling that clause sets. This is a wrong-meeting-point case decided under POL-NS-03, not a driver who was never at the venue.

POL-NS-03 limb (i) does not assign this loss to the driver. The chat log for the trip holds exactly one message and it was sent by the driver at 07:12:40 (delivered 07:12:41, read 07:13:10); the rider never posted an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier that the driver then failed to move to. The limb that strips a compensating driver of his payment is simply not engaged on this record.

Limb (ii) of POL-NS-03 does engage and fixes the driver's entitlement. The rider specified no sub-location in chat, trip_record records 2 registered pickup points at this STANDARD pickup, and the ledger fixes the cancellation fee at SGD 4.00 with pin_ambiguity_goodwill_rate of 0.5. The mislocation is therefore attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver is owed a platform-funded goodwill payment of SGD 2.00 — 50 percent of SGD 4.00 — charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

POL-NS-03 is decided from coordinates alone and requires no traffic advisory, so the only advisory artifact in the bundle is immaterial to the driver's limb (ii) claim. EV-ADVIS-00720-01 is MISSING on issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0) and carries no fact; the impairment is disclosed here, and this claim does not rest on that artifact.

The driver's account is corroborated by the telemetry and there is no sign of fee-farming. He marked arrival at 07:12:40, sent his locating message the same second ('Meet me at the service entrance 290 m east of the pin' — a party statement in the chat log), and stayed put until he cancelled at 07:19:40 after a full 7.0 minutes of waiting; meanwhile the rider's 45 qualifying fixes show a device that moves no more than 5.21 m across the window. The pickup failed at the meeting point, not because the driver drove off, ignored the rider or harvested a clock.

Nothing in the profiles withholds or escalates a driver payment. Rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged.

To be straight with the tribunal: the driver does not carry POL-NS-01 limb (b). The derived arrival facts record 0 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and a minimum driver distance of 287.81 m, so no no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 and the rider's refund follows from POL-NS-03. The driver's case is not that the charge should stand; it is that the divergence was a meeting-point ambiguity, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-03's compensation limb prices.
